headline: Nevish Line Rekindles as Stonecradle Sees Action
war_summary: Since the midday edition the Nevish Line has flared anew with seven transfers in two hours and forty-two on the day about Blackcoat Way, Tomb Father and Blinding Stones for four Warden, three Colonial and one ruined holding, last heard at 1451, with day losses near seventy-six hundred Colonial and eight thousand Warden still quickening. Linn Mercy holds hot with five in two hours and thirty-seven on the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch for eight Colonial, two Warden and one ruined holding, last at 1431. Stonecradle has quickened with six in two hours and eight on the day about The Reach and World's End for eight Colonial and one Warden holding, also last at 1431. The Weathered Expanse has fallen silent in two hours after seven in six and fifty-one on the day about Spirit Watch and Wightwalk for five Warden, two Colonial and two ruined holdings, last at 1126. Mooring County and Marban Hollow report no transfers in two hours, last at 0931 and 0346. Callahan's Passage still shows the heaviest butchery at sixty-seven hundred Colonial and fifty-two hundred Warden on the day with no transfer recorded.
